faq.question: Does it work with Facebook, X and WhatsApp?
faq.answer: Save your card as a PNG to share in posts and chats. You can also paste it from the clipboard in apps that accept pasted images.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?
faq.answer: Card support for 30 languages is planned. The examples above show Bangla, Hindi and Urdu.

faq.question: Does my data leave the browser?
faq.answer: Clipcard builds and saves cards in your browser. It may request images from the source site.

faq.question: Edge, Brave, Firefox?
faq.answer: The first extension release is planned for Chrome. Edge and Brave are part of beta testing, with Firefox planned for a later release.

privacy.title: Privacy
text: This website has no account, analytics or trackers.
Clipcard is in development. The planned browser tools will process clips and keep drafts and exports in browser storage.
In the future extension, you can grant optional access to read links you choose and enable on-page clip controls.
appText: Clipcard has no account, analytics or trackers.
The web app builds cards on your device and keeps recent cards in this browser’s storage.
When you paste or bookmark a page, the web app may ask the original site for an image. You can add a local photo if the site does not allow the request.
